global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth cradling golden noodles, topped with nori, chashu, and menma arranged neatly. Served in a white bowl on a wooden table, warm lighting highlights the steam rising from the savory, inviting dish.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle knots with smooth, slightly reflective finish.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface, slightly flared rim, and subtle inner rim indentation.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is rich amber, glossy, and swirling around golden noodles with green garnish.
regions.seaweed: Dark, glossy nori seaweed triangle with slightly uneven edges and visible surface texture.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: golden-brown, slightly glistening, irregularly shaped slice with visible fat marbling and tender texture.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, slightly translucent, with visible fibrous texture and green onion garnish on top.
